item.title: BioWare Officially Shutting Down and New Mass Effect Canceled
item.description: Electronic Arts is making big cuts, including laying off staff and shutting down storied developer BioWare, the studio behind the Mass Effect and Dragon Age franchises. The closure of BioWare means that the next Mass Effect game, colloquially known as Mass Effect 5 , which was announced in 2020 , has been canceled.

item.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’s New Haymitch Reveals Woody Harrelson’s Advice
item.description: Most of the cast of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has the unenviable task of playing younger versions of characters previously portrayed by some of our greatest actors. That is especially true for Joseph Zada, who takes over the role of Haymitch from Woody Harrelson . To make the challenge easier, the two actors were able to compare notes on set, with the latter offering some helpful — if unexpected — advice to Zada.

item.title: PC gamers can finally play a beloved 2010 PS3 masterpiece
item.description: It’s an excellent time to be a God of War fan. A few months ago, developers announced God of War Laufey , the next title in the award-winning series. Back in February, Sony made two massive announcements : the release of Sons of Sparta , a 2D prequel to God of War, and the reveal that the original God of War trilogy was getting a remake.

item.title: The 15 Best Steam Next Fest Demos to Play Right Now
item.description: Usually, Steam Next Fest is a cause for celebration. Steam's digital demo event is always a great way to find exciting and eccentric new PC games from a wide range of developers. This October's edition, which runs through Oct. 26, was especially exciting on paper given that it would give some air to upcoming games that aren't named GTA 6 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time .

item.title: 'Cyberpunk 2077' is getting a huge new co-op mod
item.description: Night City is having a busy week. Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a major 2.5 update on Oct. 22, coinciding with the recent release of the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime. CD Projekt Red just confirmed what’s in 2.5, including new quests, a perk that enables dual wielding, console mod support, and more. However, the game is arguably getting an even bigger update through unofficial channels: Cyberpunk 2077 is receiving multiplayer co-op support via the NightCoop mod.

item.title: Middle-earth Goes to War in The Rings of Power Season 3 Explosive Trailer
item.description: The flames of war threaten Middle-earth once again in the trailer for season 3 of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power . Prime Video's fantasy series will officially return to streaming on Nov. 11, as Sauron's schemes finally come to fruition and the free people of the world have to choose between bending the knee and trying to topple the Dark Lord.

item.title: New 'Pokémon' Release Reinvents The Series' Most Hated Monster Type
item.description: Every Pokémon type has its own fandom, but the least popular element has to be bug-type. No offense to any self-described Bug Catchers out there, but a category of monsters based on insects — which many people fear or loathe in real life — was never destined to be a community favorite. When you factor in the monster type's many weaknesses , and what you get is an underappreciated class of Pokémon.

item.title: How to play DMZ solo in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: A lot of people are wondering how to play DMZ solo in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , or even whether it's actually possible in the first place. I bring good news: it is definitely possible, but the setting is a little hidden, and chances are, you'll load into your first game without even seeing the option not to party up with other random solo players.

item.title: Game Pass Is Losing a Legendary Point-and-Click Masterpiece This Halloween
item.description: It's been a tough few months for Xbox , with waves of layoffs, studio closures, and the prospect of outrageously expensive next-gen hardware looming. But Xbox Game Pass continues to chug along, welcoming a wave of new games twice a month while bidding farewell to other titles in the library. There's one classic title leaving the service on Oct. 31 that you won't want to miss — and it's a short game that's a perfect fit for spooky season: 2016's Day of the Tentacle Remastered.

item.title: Expedition 33's Fan-favorite Costumes Are Unofficially Invading a Different Game
item.description: Sandfall Interactive's award-winning Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 took the gaming world by storm last year as players enjoyed the role-playing game's serious themes and its goofy bits , like the "baguette" outfits. Equip those, and the downtrodden expeditioners will suddenly look as silly as can be with red berets, black-and-white-striped shirts, and baguettes tied to their backs.
